_note: Stillway V2 S06 Product details: rolling path, poses, final ring-on-finger pose, and finger proxy. Units: 'img px' = pixels of A-1-hand-left-alpha.png (579x1198); scale them by (rendered image width / 579). Rotations are world-space steps applied in order (three.js: q = R_n * ... * R_1), degrees, for the GLB as loaded (ring axis +Z, logo at +X, sensor at -X). Camera: perspective FOV 30 deg, distance chosen so 1 world unit = 1 CSS px at z = 0 (same as V1 hero). Proposal by 3D Designer, pending user review (D-072).

image._measured: finger width measured from alpha along the axis; README value 85 px is the narrowest part, the seat is 96-100 px

ring._scale: ring.scale = (122 * imgScale) / 0.02384, imgScale = renderedImageWidth / 579. Inner diameter ~19 mm = finger 96-100 px, so 1 mm ~ 5.1 img px

frontLogoTop.use: S06 rolling + 25% stop: opening faces camera, logo at top

side.use: S06 33%: band side to camera, reflections sweep

edge45.use: S06 67%: seen from the edge at 45 deg (between front and side), tilted 20 deg so the opening shows as an ellipse and the reflection stretches along the side

onFinger.use: S06 100% (D-072): axis along the index finger, logo faces camera, text horizontal; x 10 = camera ~10 deg above, z 2.9 = finger tilt
onFinger.viewCorrection: After the steps, add world x = atan2(ring.y, camZ - ring.z) and then y = atan2(-ring.x, camZ - ring.z) (degrees from radians), ring position relative to the screen centre in px. The hand sits off-centre, so without this the camera sees the ring from the side and the logo slides off-centre. Blend it in over 0.67-0.80.

rolling._rule: Rolls on the Sand plinth: roll angle about the ring axis = distance / outerRadiusPx (clockwise when moving right). rotation = steps of frontLogoTop with the z angle = 90 - deg(dx / R), dx = x - xStop.
rolling.startX: -0.5 * ringDiameterPx (half cut off at the left edge, as the end of S05)

keyframes.note: standing on the plinth, half cut off
moving right, rolling clockwise, logo turns with it
slowing down, title starts to appear
rocks back and rests facing camera, logo on top

rolling.ease: x(p) uses power2.out until 0.22, then sine.inOut back to stop

timeline.what: hand fades in; ring moves above the fingertip, scales to onFinger size, slerp edge45 -> onFinger
ring slides down the finger axis from 40 img px above the tip to the seat (power2.inOut), proxy hides the back of the ring

fingerProxy._how: LatheGeometry around +Y, points [radius, y] in img px measured along the finger axis, y = 0 at the ring seat, up positive (radius ~4% under the photo width so the ring front never z-fights). Orientation: z 2.9 only, i.e. the proxy and the slide path stay in the photo plane (z = 0); the 10 deg camera tilt lives only in the ring pose, otherwise perspective parallax pushes the proxy off the finger. Position: ring seat. Material: depth only (colorWrite false), renderOrder below the ring.
